dif.summary: Recover one failed payment attempt without creating an unintended duplicate financial action.

allowed_paths: read the authoritative transaction state before another mutation
replay the original operation once through the verified idempotency contract
wait for stronger terminal evidence before another mutation
blocked_paths: blind non-idempotent replay while the prior commit state is unresolved
constraints: recovery must preserve the identity of the original payment operation
at most one recovery mutation may be attempted for this confirmed intent
no provider-specific adapter, credential, or live payment call is involved

drp.decision_summary: Commit to one bounded idempotent replay of the original operation and prohibit path substitution.

tip.action_summary: Execute the committed idempotent recovery path once and observe the authoritative transaction result.
